observation: One closed irregular oval has three headless rightward extensions, with the middle extension heavier and longer. A short interior segment stops just to the right of a separate filled point, leaving a visible gap; it meets a dark junction on the oval. The upper and lower extensions meet the oval separately and end at unequal horizontal positions. A small inward hook remains at the upper-left outline join. All six label groups are included. The label uncertainties were read in the separately supplied close boxes.

Both X letters have separate lower horizontal strokes; these do not extend beneath the subscripts. The first 0 is heavily filled but has a rounded closed outline, while the second 0 is open-centered. The relation has two short horizontal strokes. The right raised mark has distinct star-like projections. The clipped point and shaft along the top belong to the drawing, not the formula.

The X and its separate underline are clear, as is the terminal 1 with an oblique entry, upright stem, and broad foot. Between X and 1 a dense lower oval-like body favors an overworked 0; whether it is live or cancelled is unresolved because no independent strike is separable. Above it a projecting dark group is star-like but partly merged with that lower ink. Both symbol and revision-state doubts are retained; blackness alone is not treated as proof of deletion.

The thin lower-left numeral has a closed upper loop and long descending curved tail, reading 9. A separate short wavering stroke lies underneath it and is represented as an underline. The lower paper edge is distinct from that stroke.
The top label has two crossing X strokes, a separate raised star-like mark, and a lowered 2. The broad horizontal bottom of 2 is its own foot, not an additional underline.

The junction label reads X with lowered 0 and 1. The 0 has an open center, and 1 is a single upright with a short entry. There is no separate star or underline. The dark shaft at the upper frame edge is drawing context.

The upper extension label reads X with lowered 1 and 2. The 1 has a short sloping entry and the 2 a curved neck and horizontal foot. The line at the bottom belongs to the extension, not a label underline.
The lower extension label independently reads X with lowered 1 and 2. No raised star, underline, or terminal punctuation is visible.
